[Sharing the lot calculator I've been using lately ♪]

When trading off the charts every day, I think everyone finds lot calculation a hassle.

I've shared a free calculator site in the past, in both my YouTube videos and PDF materials ("I calculate with this site"), but it has drawbacks:

* Every calculation takes time.
* Typing in entry and stop-loss values each time is tedious.
* A typo can throw the lot size off and cause an unexpected loss.
* So you worry whether it's really correct and have to double-check.

When the scenario has been clear for hours and there is time before entry it's fine, but when you want to enter right away you get flustered, which makes mistakes more likely - a vicious circle. With no time before entry and a tedious calculation, you can't focus on chart analysis and misjudgments become more likely.

After searching around I found a very handy tool and I'm using it now: "Easy Order" (links to my blog article).
https://t.co/rIqMKqNjE0…

As explained in the blog, you don't type in numbers - you just drag three horizontal lines (entry, stop-loss, take-profit) up and down on MT4 and it automatically calculates the appropriate lot size. Market, limit and stop orders can be placed with one click, and the risk-reward ratio is displayed automatically. It removes the stress and worry of lot and risk-reward calculations.

It works with overseas FX brokers such as XM, which I use, and also with CFDs and crypto, so there is no need to split tools by asset class.

It isn't free, but at 4,500 yen it's quite reasonable. Many people who trade the same way as me already use this tool.
https://t.co/rIqMKqNjE0…

It frees you from all the hassle of lot calculation so you can concentrate on chart analysis. I recommend it to anyone who struggles with lot or risk-reward calculations - quietly sharing it on the last night of the long weekend. 😁

2125485579605528727.content_en:
[On overseas FX deposit/withdrawal regulation]

Many of you may be worried, but let's first understand it correctly.

The focus of this regulation is not "overseas FX itself" but the "payment agents".

It is not illegal for Japanese residents to use overseas FX and make deposits and withdrawals.

■ About bank deposits/withdrawals

- It doesn't look like bank deposits/withdrawals will suddenly all become unusable.
- You may be asked to confirm transaction details and the source of funds.
(As mentioned before, overseas FX is not illegal)
- Depending on the bank, account restrictions or freezes are possible.

Even if an account is frozen, your funds are not confiscated. However, confirmation and release may take time.

I recommend separating your main bank used for living expenses and salary from the bank account used for overseas FX.

■ About crypto deposits/withdrawals

Each broker recommends using crypto for deposits and withdrawals.

From now on, it is good to understand crypto deposit/withdrawal methods rather than relying only on bank transfers.
I will put together the crypto deposit/withdrawal flow later.

■ About credit cards

They remain available.

However, in some cases withdrawals are made by bank transfer rather than refunded to the card, so check each broker's deposit/withdrawal rules in advance.

■ Summary

This regulation does not prohibit the use of overseas FX.

What matters is:

- Secure multiple deposit/withdrawal methods
- Separate living-expense and trading accounts
- Keep transaction history and deposit/withdrawal records

There's no need to be overly anxious.

It's important to understand correct information and adapt to changes in the environment.

That said, this is only my personal opinion at this point. I'm also in talks with each broker, so let's keep updating with the latest information.

【海外FXの入出金規制について】

不安に感じている方も多いと思いますが、まず正しく理解しておきましょう。

今回の規制の焦点は「海外FXそのもの」ではなく「収納代行業者」です。

日本居住者が海外FXを利用し、入出金すること自体が違法となるわけではありません。

■ 銀行入出金について

・銀行入出金が一斉に使えなくなるということは無さそうです。
・取引内容や資金の出所について確認される可能性があります。
（前述してますが海外FXは違法ではありません）
・銀行によっては口座の利用制限や凍結の可能性もあります。

口座が凍結されたからといって、資金が没収されるわけではありません。ただし、確認や解除に時間がかかる可能性はあります。

生活費や給与振込に利用しているメインバンクと、海外FX用の銀行口座は分けておくことをおすすめします。

■ 仮想通貨入出金について

各ブローカーは仮想通貨での入出金利用を推奨しています。

今後は銀行入出金だけに依存せず、仮想通貨での入出金方法も理解しておくと良いでしょう。
こちらは後日仮想通貨入出金の導線をまとめておきます。

■ クレジットカードについて

引き続き利用可能です。

ただし、カードへの返金ではなく、銀行送金での出金となるケースもあるため、各ブローカーの入出金ルールを事前に確認しておきましょう。

■ まとめ

今回の規制は、海外FXの利用を禁止するものではありません。

重要なのは、

・入出金手段を複数確保する
・生活用口座と取引用口座を分ける
・取引履歴や入出金記録を保管する

過度に不安になる必要はありません。

正しい情報を理解し、環境の変化に対応していくことが大切です。

ただあくまで現時点での個人的な意見ではあります。勿論各ブローカーとも話しをしている段階ですので、常に最新の情報を更新していきましょう。
